versions.changelog: The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

shift-handoff-voice 0.1.1

- Initial release of the shift handoff voice skill.
- Converts a written shift handoff checklist into 8–20 labeled voice clips, one per cue.
- Handles outgoing, incoming, and unfinished work priorities.
- Supports both catalog and cloned staff voices, ensuring secure consent and billing checks.
- Executes all operations through the bundled MCP client and strictly follows provided checklists without inventing extra content.
- Provides detailed instructions for authorization, billing, delivery, error recovery, and safe automatic updates.
